units.source_text: 第三年的暑假，就是我下决心永远告别父母的墓地的那一年。

en.t: During the summer vacation of my third year, I made up my mind to say farewell forever to my parents' graves.
I urged K to go home, but he did not want to.

units.source_text: 他说每年都回去有什么意思，看样子他还是打算留在东京学习。

en.t: He said there was no point in going home every year, and it seemed he still meant to stay in Tokyo and study.

units.source_text: 没办法，我只好一个人回了乡下。

en.t: With no other choice, I went back to the country alone.

units.source_text: 我在家乡度过的这两个月，给我的命运带来了怎样的波澜，前面已说过，不再重复了。

en.t: I have already described what turmoil those two months in my hometown brought to my fate, so I will not repeat it here.

units.source_text: 九月，我满怀愤怒、阴郁和孤独回到东京，又见到了K。

en.t: In September, filled with anger, gloom, and loneliness, I returned to Tokyo and saw K again.

units.source_text: 此时，他的命运同我一样，也发生了变化。

en.t: By then, his fate, like mine, had also changed.

units.source_text: 原来我不在的这些日子，他给养父家写了一封信，主动坦白了自己的欺骗行为。

en.t: It turned out that while I had been away, he had written a letter to his adoptive family and confessed on his own to his deception.

units.source_text: 看来他一开始就盘算好了，大概是想迫使养父承认既成事实，

en.t: It seems he had planned it from the beginning, probably wanting to force his adoptive father to accept the accomplished fact,

units.source_text: 主动说出‘既然已经这样了，你想学什么就学什么好了’这样的话来。

en.t: and make him say of his own accord, 'Since things have already come to this, you may study whatever you like.'

units.source_text: 总之，他似乎并没有打算一直到大学都欺瞒养父母。

en.t: In any case, it seems he had not meant to keep deceiving his adoptive parents all the way through university.

units.source_text: 也许他认识到了，即便能欺瞒一时，也欺瞒不了一世。

en.t: Perhaps he realized that even if he could deceive them for a while, he could not deceive them forever.
